Kit summary

UnityBasic
Deals 300% ATK DMG to a single enemy, and reduces CD of Concentration Increase and Broken Snow by 1 turn.
Concentration IncreaseActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Enters [Concentration Increase] status for 1 turn, during which increases self Crit Rate by 50% and Crit DMG by 150%. This effect cannot be removed.
Shadow on Snowfield Lv.1Concentration Increase: Additionally increases Piercing Rate by 30%, and Xia gains immunity to control effects when under such status.
Shadow on Snowfield Lv.2Shadow of Master: Deals 50% of the DMG dealt by this skill to all enemies other than the target of the attack. When under [Concentration Increase] status, each time Xia triggers Shadow of Master successfully, the chance to pursue and attack with this skill will be reduced by 34% and Xia will try to trigger it again. When the chance is less than 34% or Xia fails to trigger the skill, she will stop trying and reset the chance.
Shadow on Snowfield Lv.3Broken Snow: Resets its cooldown and increases self Turn Meter by 50% when it inflicts a kill. Xia acts 1 more turn if she is under [Concentration Increase] status at this time.
Shadow of MasterPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Each time Xia takes action, she has a 100% chance to pursue and attack the target with the lowest HP once, dealing 200% ATK DMG.
Shadow on Snowfield Lv.2Shadow of Master: Deals 50% of the DMG dealt by this skill to all enemies other than the target of the attack. When under [Concentration Increase] status, each time Xia triggers Shadow of Master successfully, the chance to pursue and attack with this skill will be reduced by 34% and Xia will try to trigger it again. When the chance is less than 34% or Xia fails to trigger the skill, she will stop trying and reset the chance.
